sourceFile: 52. BRS-161014  Report test VP change mold press 90, dry 2nd 120⁰C and 150⁰C date 20.7.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable data but misidentifies the primary change and loses key test-condition grouping.
issues: Primary changed factor should be 2nd dry 120C vs 150C at mold press 90, not VP mold list.
VP mold numbers are subgroup keys, not the main changed condition.
Continuation rows omit inherited TEST 1/TEST 2 and dry-temperature context.
Normal function rows and decision context are not fully captured.
Measurement outcomes are header-derived and not reliable evidence.
correctionPlan: Redefine changed factor as TEST 1 120C versus TEST 2 150C with mold press 90 fixed.
Preserve subgroup keys: date, line, lot date, VP mold, test round, dry temp.
Attach inherited test/dry context to every VP mold subresult.
Include Normal function rows only as reference/baseline where supported.
Remove or rebuild header-only measurement outcomes from actual data rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient until corrected.
